<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">&quot;I kept waiting until I could build something perfect. Then someone got lost in the trees, and I built something that worked.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">&quot;If it stops, I hope you will mend it. You do not have to be its maker to care for it.&quot;</p>
